_comment: All gameplay tunables live here. Core rules must not hardcode numbers.

unlock._comment: strategy=byMaxReachedLevel: a level enters the spawn pool only after the player has created it by merging. spawnWeights[n-1] is the relative weight of level n; the table is truncated to maxReachedLevel and re-normalised.
unlock._spawnWeightsComment: Relative weight of level 1..N. The tail is deliberately thin: once a level unlocks it must stay a treat, not become a common draw. Raise the later entries if high levels feel too rare in playtesting.

stepUnlockFallback._comment: Optional accelerator if playtesting shows the mid-game drags. Disabled by default.

cascade._comment: Auto chain merges until the board is stable.

obstacles._comment: hits=2: a merge next to an obstacle cracks it, a second merge breaks it. breakOutrightAtMaxLevel lets a max-level (5-level) clear destroy obstacles in one hit instead. clearBonus is paid only when an obstacle is actually destroyed, not when it cracks.
